primary_explanation: The signSGD paper presents convergence results and convergence-rate theorems for SIGNSGD/SIGNUM under its assumptions and argues SIGNSGD achieves SGD-level convergence; it does not state that SignSGD may fail to converge in the general sense. Using Bernstein et al. to support the claim that SignSGD "may fail to converge" is therefore not supported by the cited paper (and in fact the paper offers positive convergence results), so the citation is inappropriate for that negative claim.
